title: Leta Tap Styles (And My Autistic Life) - Videos
channel: Leta Tap Styles (And My Autistic Life)
description:
Welcome to Leta's Tap Styles (And My Autistic Life)! This mother-daughter podcast, hosted by autistic tap dancer Leta (14) and her mom, Amanda, celebrates the intersection of tap dance and autism.

On Tap Tuesday, Leta shares her journey with Chloe Arnold's "SoleTalk" company and gives updates on Autistic Wings Dance Company, the nonprofit studio she founded for autistic dancers.

On Fridays, we welcome guests from the autistic community—from parents to doctors, therapists, and professionals—for candid, meaningful conversations.

Leta also posts her new tap videos here.

Proudly a part of the PodMatch Podcast Network!
To be a guest, please apply via the PodMatch link on our channel's page.
